name: Soulbound Route
source:
You woke up in a bus heading towards the afterlife, but you remembered being in a party. How did you get here? 

Perhaps the man sitting beside you has a clue...

[from [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/soulbound-route]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一辆驶向来世的公共汽车上醒来，但你记得自己正在参加一个聚会。你是怎么到这里来的？

也许坐在你旁边的那个人有线索……

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/soulbound-route]itch.io[/url]]
